solver, model proof record, source-body success or resolved-import claim is made.

'/data1/yanruj/probata-verifiers/home/.why3.conf', 'sha256': '50061c22ad10615b4cd0103721869646155b681e0317a679682aed719f0967c9'}}
project=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
output=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
repo=project.parent
if output.is_relative_to(repo) or not output.is_dir():
    raise SystemExit('coordinator existing raw output must be outside bootstrap checkout')
os.chdir(project)
sys.path.insert(0,str(project))
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-replace-objects','-C',str(repo),*args],timeout=30)
def source_check():
    if git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()!=EXPECTED['bootstrap_commit']:
        raise SystemExit('bootstrap source mismatch')
    if git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all').strip():
        raise SystemExit('bootstrap checkout dirty')
def pin(path):
    p=pathlib.Path(path)
    return {'path':str(p.resolve()),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
source_check()
ambient=sorted(k for k in os.environ if k.startswith('FRAMAC_WP'))
if ambient:
    raise SystemExit('forbidden ambient WP settings: '+','.join(ambient))
ref=EXPECTED['theory_commit']+':'+EXPECTED['theory_path']
blob=git('rev-parse','--verify',ref).decode().strip()
body=git('show',ref)
if blob!=EXPECTED['theory_blob'] or hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()!=EXPECTED['theory_sha256']:
    raise SystemExit('new theory Git blob mismatch')
theory=output/'theory';theory.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
staged=theory/'heap_bridge.mlw';staged.write_bytes(body)
verified={}
for name,want in EXPECTED['tools'].items():
    found=shutil.which(name)
    if found is None or pathlib.Path(found).resolve()!=pathlib.Path(want['path']).resolve():
        raise SystemExit('selected tool path mismatch: '+name)
    got=pin(found)
    if got['sha256']!=want['sha256']:
        raise SystemExit('selected tool byte mismatch: '+name)
    verified[name]=got
artifacts=[]
for path,digest in EXPECTED['wp_artifacts'].items():
    got=pin(path)
    if got['sha256']!=digest:
        raise SystemExit('pinned WP artifact mismatch')
    artifacts.append(got)
stdlib=pathlib.Path(EXPECTED['why3_stdlib'])
stdlib_rows=[{'path':str(p.relative_to(stdlib)),'sha256':pin(p)['sha256']} for p in sorted(stdlib.rglob('*.mlw'))]
stdlib_digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(stdlib_rows,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
if len(stdlib_rows)!=EXPECTED['stdlib_count'] or stdlib_digest!=EXPECTED['stdlib_tree_sha256']:
    raise SystemExit('declared standard-library physical tree mismatch')
config=pin(EXPECTED['config']['path'])
if config['sha256']!=EXPECTED['config']['sha256']:
    raise SystemExit('pinned Why3 config mismatch')
command=[verified['why3']['path'],'prove','--type-only','--no-stdlib','--no-load-default-plugins',
         '--config',config['path'],'-L',str(stdlib),str(staged)]
receipt={'created':'2026-10-15 ET','bootstrap_commit':EXPECTED['bootstrap_commit'],
         'theory_input_commit':EXPECTED['theory_commit'],'theory_input_path':EXPECTED['theory_path'],
         'theory_git_blob':blob,'staged_theory':pin(staged),'selected_tools':verified,'wp_artifacts':artifacts,
         'stdlib_tree':{'path':str(stdlib),'count':len(stdlib_rows),'sha256':stdlib_digest,'files':stdlib_rows},
         'why3_config':config,'ambient_wp_present_names':ambient,'command':command,
         'scope':'Standalone Why3 grammar/type check only; old bootstrap and new Git input are distinct. Actual WP import/VC/task closure remains unvalidated.',
         'wp_launched':False,'solver_launched':False,'model_body_proof_records_created':0}
profile=output/'typecheck-profile.json'
def save():profile.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
save()
version=subprocess.run([verified['why3']['path'],'--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
receipt['why3_version']={'exit_code':version.returncode,'stdout':version.stdout,'stderr':version.stderr}
if version.returncode or version.stdout.strip()!='Why3 platform, version 1.8.2':
    save();raise SystemExit('selected Why3 version mismatch')
from swdb.rss_watchdog import run
run_result=run(command,log=output/'typecheck.log',cwd=output,env=dict(os.environ),cap_bytes=8589934592,timeout=60)
receipt['why3_typechecker_launched']=True
receipt['resources']=dataclasses.asdict(run_result)
source_check()
receipt['bootstrap_after_clean']=True
receipt['syntax_typecheck_passed']=bool(run_result.exit_code==0 and not run_result.timed_out and not run_result.out_of_memory)
save()
raise SystemExit(0 if receipt['syntax_typecheck_passed'] else 1)
